summary: Comprehensive testing of Habari Stays hotel booking platform completed successfully. Backend API tests (22/22 passed) and frontend UI tests verified all major flows: landing page, language toggle (SW/EN), admin dashboard with 5 tabs, hotel search, imported vs verified hotel handling, and complete booking flow with mock M-Pesa payment.
passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero, search form, featured cities
Search page shows 4 hotels (3 imported, 1 verified)
Imported hotels show 'Wasiliana Moja kwa Moja' badge and contact buttons
Admin dashboard shows stats (6 hotels, 3 bookings, 1 pending owner, TZS 25,000 revenue)
Admin Hotels tab shows all 6 hotels with status badges
Admin Owners tab shows pending owner with approve/reject buttons
Admin Import tab shows Excel upload UI
Hotel detail for imported shows contact buttons (no Book Now)
Hotel detail for verified shows room types with prices
Booking flow step 1 - guest details form
Booking flow step 3 - M-Pesa payment with 2-min timer

seed_data.hotels: 6 total (1 verified Matvilla Hotel, 3 imported, 2 pending)
seed_data.bookings: Multiple test bookings created during testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Backend is monolithic FastAPI (2100+ lines) in server.py. Frontend uses React with lazy-loaded pages. Verified hotels allow online booking with M-Pesa mock payment. Imported hotels only show contact info. Beem SMS is configured but runs as background task. Admin dashboard has 5 tabs: Dashibodi, Hoteli, Wamiliki, Weka Hazina, Import Hotels.

mocked_apis.M-Pesa Payment: Payment is mocked - user clicks 'Nimemaliza Kulipa' (I have finished paying) to confirm. No real Selcom/M-Pesa integration yet.
mocked_apis.SMS: Beem SMS integration is REAL (API configured) but runs as background task. Verify in logs if needed.

verified_features: Landing page with hero section, search form, featured cities
Hotel cards showing status (verified vs imported)
Imported hotels: Contact Directly badge, WhatsApp/Call buttons, no Book Now
Verified hotels: Room types with prices, Book Now button
4-step booking flow: Guest details → Summary → M-Pesa payment (2-min timer) → Confirmation
Admin dashboard with stats cards and charts
Admin Hotels tab with verify/suspend/attach-owner actions
Admin Owners tab with approve/reject pending owners
Admin Import Hotels tab with Excel upload
